Let me give an example

ggplot(data0207, aes(x = factor(1), fill = factor(use,labels=fet))
) + geom_bar(width = 1)

even if i add + scale_colour_grey(use)  
it still stay with color

how to "fix" it?

or example 2

g0207hdfet<-ggplot(dados0207, aes(x = factor(data0207$Hd))) + geom_bar(aes(fill = factor(data0207$fet,labels=labelfaixaetaria )), position = 'fill')+scale_fill_discrete("Fet") +labs(x = "Hd", y = "Proportion")
g0207hdfet

even if i add +scale_colour_grey( data0207$fet )   don't work!

Thanks

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Bar color plot into black and white
parts:
Felipe, 

I know it's slightly unintuitive, but you are using a "fill" and telling it to use a "color" scale. 

Try 
+ scale_fill_gray()

It should fill the barplot with varying levels of grey so it can be printed in B&W.
